fintech.desc_zh: 金融科技公司和金融技术供应商的榜单。
fintech.desc_en: Lists of fintech companies and financial technology suppliers.

women.desc_zh: 女性职场和性别平等方面的雇主榜单。
women.desc_en: Employer lists for women at work and gender equality.

unicorn.desc_zh: 估值 10 亿美元以上、尚未上市的创业公司。
unicorn.desc_en: Private start-ups valued at $1bn or more.

growth.desc_zh: 按营收增长排名的公司、热门创业公司和英国国王企业奖得主。
growth.desc_en: Companies ranked by revenue growth, rising start-ups and King's Award for Enterprise winners.

ai.desc_zh: 人工智能领域的创业公司榜单。

employer.desc_zh: 按员工评价或人力资源认证评出的英国最佳雇主。
employer.desc_en: UK best employers, rated by staff reviews or HR certification.

forbes_fintech50.zh: 福布斯金融科技 50 强

idc_fintech100.coverage_zh: 2024–2026 年完整；2022、2023 年公开资料只列出部分公司。

forbes_women.zh: 福布斯全球女性最佳雇主
forbes_women.en: Forbes World's Top Companies for Women
forbes_women.coverage_zh: 2023–2026 年，每年 400 家，完整收录；2021、2022 年的数据在福布斯网站上已不完整。
forbes_women.coverage_en: 2023–2026, 400 a year, complete; 2021 and 2022 are no longer complete on Forbes.

times_gender50.zh: 泰晤士报性别平等雇主 50 强
times_gender50.en: The Times Top 50 Employers for Gender Equality
times_gender50.publisher: The Times × Business in the Community
times_gender50.coverage_zh: 2022–2026 年，每年 50 家，完整收录（2022 年名为 Top 50 Employers for Women）。
times_gender50.coverage_en: 2022–2026, 50 a year, complete (called Top 50 Employers for Women in 2022).

cbinsights_unicorns.zh: CB Insights 独角兽全名单
cbinsights_unicorns.en: CB Insights Complete List of Unicorn Companies
cbinsights_unicorns.coverage_zh: 实时名单，2026 年 10 月抓取，约 1,450 家（已上市或跌出的公司不在其中）。
cbinsights_unicorns.coverage_en: Live list taken October 2026, about 1,450 companies (those that listed or dropped out are not included).

hurun_unicorns.coverage_zh: 只收录 2026 年报告里点名的英国独角兽；完整名单放在网页表格控件里，无法提取。
hurun_unicorns.coverage_en: Only the UK unicorns named in the 2026 report; the full list sits in an embedded table that can't be extracted.

pwc_unicorns100.zh: 普华永道全球独角兽 100 强
pwc_unicorns100.coverage_zh: 2022–2025 年报告只公布汇总，不列完整 100 家；这里只收录报告正文点名的公司。
pwc_unicorns100.coverage_en: The 2022–2025 reports publish totals, not the full 100; only companies named in the text are included.

cbinsights_fintech100.zh: CB Insights 金融科技 100 强
cbinsights_fintech100.coverage_zh: 2023–2026 年，从榜单图片逐个转录，可能有个别拼写差异；2022 年发布的是 Fintech 250，未收录。
cbinsights_fintech100.coverage_en: 2023–2026, transcribed from the list images, so a few spellings may differ; 2022 was the Fintech 250 and isn't included.

wifc.zh: 金融业女性宪章签署机构
wifc.coverage_zh: 英国政府数据。2026 年 6 月的当前签署名单，约 420 家；名单只有当前版本，没有按年份。
wifc.coverage_en: UK government data. Current signatories as of June 2026, about 420; only the current list exists, not one per year.

gender_pay_gap.zh: 性别薪酬差距小的雇主
gender_pay_gap.en: Employers with a small gender pay gap
gender_pay_gap.publisher: UK gender pay gap service (英国政府)
gender_pay_gap.coverage_zh: 英国政府数据，250 人以上雇主必须申报。筛选条件：时薪中位数差距 ≤ 5%，且薪酬最高四分之一里女性 ≥ 40%，近 5 个申报年里至少 3 年符合。年份按公布年份记（2021/22 申报年记为 2022）。
gender_pay_gap.coverage_en: UK government data; employers with 250+ staff must report. Included if the median hourly pay gap is 5% or less and women are at least 40% of the top pay quarter, in at least 3 of the last 5 reporting years. Years are the year published (2021/22 shows as 2022).

gptw_best.coverage_zh: 2022–2026 年，大、中、小型组织全部类别，完整收录，约 1,000 家。
gptw_best.coverage_en: 2022–2026, all size categories, complete, about 1,000 organisations.

glassdoor_uk.zh: Glassdoor 英国最佳工作场所
glassdoor_uk.en: Glassdoor Best Places to Work UK
glassdoor_uk.coverage_zh: 2022–2026 年，每年 50 家，按员工匿名评价评出，完整收录。
glassdoor_uk.coverage_en: 2022–2026, 50 a year, based on anonymous staff reviews, complete.

top_employers_uk.coverage_zh: 2026 年约 100 家（来自媒体公布的完整名单）；2025 年只找到媒体点名的 23 家；更早年份没有公开名单。
top_employers_uk.coverage_en: 2026: about 100 (full list published in the press); 2025: only the 23 named in the press; no public list for earlier years.

statista_best_employers_uk.zh: 英国最佳雇主（Statista × 金融时报）
statista_best_employers_uk.coverage_zh: 2025、2026 年，每年 500 家，基于大规模员工匿名调查，完整收录；更早年份 Statista 已不提供。
statista_best_employers_uk.coverage_en: 2025 and 2026, 500 a year, based on a large anonymous staff survey, complete; earlier years are no longer on Statista.

forbes_ai50.coverage_zh: 2022–2026 年，每年 50 家，完整收录。大多是美国公司。
forbes_ai50.coverage_en: 2022–2026, 50 a year, complete. Mostly US companies.

cbinsights_ai100.coverage_zh: 2022、2024、2025、2026 年，从榜单图片逐个转录；2023 年的榜单页没有找到。
cbinsights_ai100.coverage_en: 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026, transcribed from the list images; the 2023 page couldn't be found.

ft1000_uk.zh: 金融时报欧洲增长最快公司 1000 强（英国部分）
ft1000_uk.coverage_zh: 2025、2026 年，只收总部在英国的公司（每年 130–180 家）；2022–2024 年 Statista 已不提供。
ft1000_uk.coverage_en: 2025 and 2026, UK-headquartered companies only (130–180 a year); 2022–2024 are no longer on Statista.

linkedin_startups_uk.zh: 领英英国热门创业公司
linkedin_startups_uk.coverage_en: 2022–2025, 15–20 a year, complete; the 2026 edition wasn't found yet.

kings_awards.coverage_zh: 英国政府奖项，含国际贸易、创新、可持续发展、促进机会四类。2022–2026 年（2022 年为女王企业奖），从政府公报 PDF 解析，个别名称可能被拆开或合并。
kings_awards.coverage_en: UK government award for international trade, innovation, sustainable development and promoting opportunity. 2022–2026 (Queen's Awards in 2022), parsed from Gazette PDFs, so a few names may be split or joined.

missing.en: CNBC × Statista Top Fintech Companies UK

missing.zh: 毕马威 × H2 Ventures 金融科技 100 强
missing.reason_zh: 2019 年后停办，最近一期已超出 5 年范围，不收录。

missing.zh: 德勤 EMEA 科技 Fast 500
missing.reason_zh: 网页只列前几名，完整 500 家名单不公开发布，暂未收录。英国部分基本已被德勤英国 Fast 50 覆盖。
